name: Zehenteralm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Zehenteralm in Tirol** – a breathtaking alpine paradise nestled in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, this sun-drenched high-alpine meadow at **1,800 meters** offers panoramic views of jagged peaks, lush meadows, and crystal-clear lakes.

### **A Summer Oasis**
Escape the hustle and enjoy the fresh mountain air while indulging in traditional **Tiroler** hospitality. The **Zehenteralm** is the perfect starting point for unforgettable hikes, from gentle trails through wildflower meadows to challenging ascents to **Hochfeiler** or **Ahornspitze**. Don’t miss the chance to spot **Edelweiss**, **Alpine ibex**, or **marmots** along the way.

After an active day, unwind at the **Almhütte** with a hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, a cold **Zillertaler Bier**, or a glass of **Grüner Veltliner**. The rustic charm of the wooden huts and the crackling fire make every moment feel like a fairy tale.

### **Winter Wonderland**
When snow blankets the **Zehenteralm**, it transforms into a magical ski and snowboard paradise. The **Zillertal Arena** ski area, connected by a scenic gondola, offers over **120 km of perfectly groomed slopes** for all levels—whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro. After skiing, warm up with **Tiroler Gröstl**, **Käsekrainer**, or a steaming bowl of **Käsespätzle** by the cozy fireplace.

### **Family-Friendly Fun**
Families will love the **Alm’s** playful atmosphere, from **pony rides** and **hayrides** in summer to **snowshoeing** and **sleigh rides** in winter. Kids can also enjoy the **Alm’s** playground and meet friendly farm animals like **cows, sheep, and goats**.

### **Stay & Relax**
Whether you choose a cozy **Almhütte**, a modern **Hotel**, or a charming **Ferienwohnung**, the **Zehenteralm** promises an unforgettable retreat. With its **sunny location**, **stunning scenery**, and **authentic Tyrolean warmth**, it’s the ideal destination for nature lovers, adventure seekers, and those simply looking to slow down and soak in the beauty of the **Alps**.

**Plan your escape to Zehenteralm in Tirol** – where every season feels like a postcard come to life!
